name: xgoose-mcp

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Create or resume this agent’s cross-tab transcript. Set includeTabs:true to receive a compact tab list in the same call. Keep the returned sessionId for all calls by this agent.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: Finish the session after pending tools settle.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List tab IDs, URLs, titles and active skill names. Also refresh this session’s page bindings after navigation.

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open an http(s) URL in a background tab and wait for tools.

tools.name: navigate_tab
tools.description: Navigate the specified tab and wait for the new document.

tools.name: list_page_tools
tools.description: Compact page-tool directory by default. Provide name to retrieve one full input schema. Reuse known schemas, or pass ifVersion for a conditional response.

tools.name: help_skill
tools.description: Describe a website skill. Omit function for a short name/summary directory; provide function for only that function’s full input schema. Cache by returned version; reuse known schemas instead of calling help every time. ifVersion returns unchanged when already known.

tools.name: call_skill
tools.description: Call a website skill directly on tabId: skill, function, args. No documentId or nested skill_call wrapper is needed. Reuse known function arguments; help_skill is only needed for unfamiliar functions.

tools.name: call_page_tool
tools.description: Execute a page tool on tabId. Document binding is managed by the bridge; documentId is an optional legacy override. Use call_skill for website functions. Results include text and images.

instructions: Start one session per agent/task with includeTabs:true to get the sessionId and compact tab list together. Reuse that sessionId across tabs, then end_session. For website functions use call_skill(tabId,skill,function,args) directly. Known tools and function schemas can be reused without discovery. For unfamiliar functions use help_skill with a specific function; omitting function returns only a compact directory. Cache descriptions by version and use ifVersion when checking for changes. list_page_tools is optional: it returns a compact directory, or one full schema when name is specified. Document IDs are managed internally. On page_changed, inspect currentUrl and refresh with list_tabs before continuing. Reuse existing tabs; open_tab creates background pages, navigate_tab changes their URL, close_tab cleans up temporary task pages. The panel can stay closed. Unknown execution outcomes are not automatically replayed.
